target_customer: Musicians who stream live and fans who watch and tip them
problem: Live music performers lacked a fun, community focused place to stream and interact with fans.
business_model: Consumer live streaming platform (monetization not sourced)

founders.name: Kyle Michelson
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder & CEO of Italic Health and angel investor, previously founder of Getlabs (acquired by Function Health) and Streamup. Those later roles are not prior employers at founding.

competitors.name: YouNow
competitors.what: Live social video streaming app used by musicians
competitors.traction_then: Not stated in the cited source

competitors.name: Periscope
competitors.what: Twitter owned live video app used by musicians

technical_complexity.rationale: Live video streaming and chat at scale is standard but infrastructure heavy for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Community could create network effects but larger platforms and Facebook Live offered substitutes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A June 2016 article lists Periscope, Meerkat, YouNow, Twitch and Facebook Live as the consumer options for musicians.

market_need_then: 2016 coverage says live video was growing for music; a 2016 industry report cited Streamup claiming around 23 million subscribers.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found; coverage was about executive moves.

outcome_analysis: Streamup was a two person live music streaming startup in YC Winter 2016 that took roughly 120 thousand dollars from YC and lost its president Will Keenan in March 2016. It is listed inactive on the YC directory but no shutdown news or cause was found, so failure factors are left empty although large platforms like Periscope and YouNow were strong rivals.
notes: Funding rests on CB Insights only (total 220K over 2 rounds, investors YC, Social Starts, NXTP Ventures; investor of the 2015 round not shown); a 2025 blog says a single 120K seed. Will Keenan was President and Chief Content Officer (Tubefilter, 2015), not described as co-founder in opened sources, so not listed. Periscope source is June 2016, about three months after the batch. streamup.com loads a live music page but shows no active streams; status unconfirmed.
